baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives جاهد and اغلظ act on الكفار and المنافقين.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sustained costly exertion meets two architectures of evasion: a cover that hides truth and a passage that displays one entrance while concealing another exit. Firmness keeps the encounter from being absorbed into concealment, redirection, or accommodation.

activation_trace.role: Full exertion under hardship makes the command sustained pressure rather than a single encounter.
Covering supplies the overt opponent's mechanism of occluding what should remain visible.
A shown entrance with a hidden exit supplies the covert opponent's mechanism of plausible entry and concealed escape.
Rough severity in speech or dealing gives the resistance an unyielding interpersonal surface.

changed_reading.before: A generic order to fight two enemy groups.
changed_reading.after: A sustained anti-evasion campaign differentiated by overt covering and covert exit-making, with firmness preventing either mechanism from redirecting the encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive sequence مأواهم جهنم and the evaluative close بئس المصير complete the two imperatives.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those figured by hidden passages seek usable exits, but مأوى gathers them into a receiving place and مصير names both becoming and settled destination. Hell is therefore not an appended threat only; it reverses evasive mobility into terminal lodging.

activation_trace.role: A through-passage with an outlet supplies the attempted spatial escape.
Joining a gathering refuge turns movement into reception by a containing destination.
A place of settlement makes the endpoint a fixed lodging rather than an abstract outcome.
The formal word of blame marks that terminal lodging as the condemned reversal.

changed_reading.before: Hell is a punishment notice added after the confrontation command.
changed_reading.after: The destination finishes the ayah's spatial logic: hidden exits and covering cannot prevent an eventual gathering into a fixed, condemned refuge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The title النبي directly precedes جاهد, while the opponents' roots encode covering and concealed passage.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prophetic title can carry both mediation of divine report and the branch image of a clear, easy road; the exertion branch can make a path or truth emerge. Together they permit a path-clearing reading in which confrontation keeps revelation publicly traversable against occlusion and hidden exits.

activation_trace.role: The one who reports from God fixes the command within a revelatory office.
The clear-road image turns that office into an exploratory route-making function.
Emergence and visible possibility supply the exertion's path-clearing effect.
Covering names what obstructs the route's visibility.
A tunnel with an outlet names the rival route that evades public accountability.

changed_reading.before: The prophetic title is an honorific followed by a combat command.
changed_reading.after: The title and command can form a revelatory path-clearing commission: make the public route visible and resist both cover and covert bypass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier prophetic address rebukes a tightening that blocks what God opened, while the next ayah supplies release and corrective restraint. The later اغلظ therefore reads as targeted, law-bounded firmness toward named evasive mechanisms, not a general disposition to make life narrower.

activation_trace.role: Tightening by withholding softness supplies the nearby example of severity aimed in the wrong direction.
Dissolution of a prohibition preserves an opened lawful space against self-imposed narrowing.
Restraint that restores order gives firmness a corrective rather than indiscriminate function.
Severe dealing is retained but receives its proper named objects and boundary.

structural_cues: The same vocative to the Prophet opens 66:1 and 66:9; the first corrects self-narrowing before the second commands object-specific firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rebuked prohibition, released restriction, corrective restraint, and later severity; I infer a contrast that bounds the severity's direction. A live alternative is that the two addresses treat separate matters without qualifying one another.

changed_reading.before: Be harsh as a generally severe temperament.
changed_reading.after: Exercise corrective firmness specifically against truth-covering and covert evasion, without converting lawful or intimate space into a field of indiscriminate harshness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A secret enters circulation, is exposed, and is handled selectively: part is identified and part is left aside. Hearts then incline and mutual backing becomes possible. This activates the hidden-exit image of نفاق as an information-and-alliance mechanism, so جهاد can include calibrated disclosure and resistance to covert coalition rather than indiscriminate exposure.

activation_trace.role: Concealment in the interior supplies the information initially kept from view.
Emergence into visibility reverses the secret's hidden state.
Partition into portions makes the disclosure deliberately selective.
Turning aside supplies the choice not to pursue every exposed portion.
A heart's inclination turns hidden information into a live allegiance vector.
The visible entrance and concealed outlet synthesize the preceding secrecy, selective exposure, and divided allegiance.

structural_cues: The dense repetition of n-b-ʾ reporting in 66:3 surrounds secret, exposure, partial acknowledgment, and partial turning-aside before 66:4 names inclined hearts and mutual backing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a secrecy-to-exposure sequence and an allegiance condition; I infer that these are local mechanics for the focus ayah's covert category. A live alternative is that the household episode only analogizes, rather than specifies, public hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: Confront hypocrisy as an already visible enemy identity.
changed_reading.after: Confront the concealed channels by which information and allegiance split, using selective exposure and refusal of covert backing rather than disclosure without limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding direct addresses assign distinct operations: believers place selves and households in protection, believers undertake an unalloyed return, and the Prophet in his reporting office performs the public confrontation. The singular focus imperative is therefore one role in a distributed response, not an undifferentiated command to everyone.

activation_trace.role: Placing oneself in protection assigns believers a self-and-household guarding operation.
A summons to turn back assigns believers an open corrective operation before the focus address.
Purity from admixture makes that return internally undivided.
The divine reporter title locates the singular confrontation within prophetic office.

structural_cues: The address sequence is believers in 66:6, disbelievers in 66:7, believers in 66:8, and the Prophet in 66:9; plural guard/repent imperatives give way to singular جاهد.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating addressees and different imperatives; I infer deliberate role allocation. A live alternative is that the prophetic command also generalizes beyond its immediate grammatical addressee.

changed_reading.before: A general mandate in which the community's main task is confrontation.
changed_reading.after: A differentiated program: believers guard and repair themselves, while the Prophet as public revelatory office confronts organized concealment and evasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same hardness field first describes agents stationed over the fire, immediately qualified by non-disobedience and exact performance of command. Its echo in اغلظ links prophetic firmness to administered consequence and constrains it by command, while the temporal order lets the focus confrontation function preventively before final refuge.

activation_trace.role: Severe dealing supplies the exact lexical echo that precedes the focus imperative.
Strength and solidity intensify the echo as capacity to hold a boundary.
The explicit negation of leaving obedience constrains severity by a superior command.
Binding request supplies the rule that governs execution rather than personal anger.
The imperative reuses severity as a present human stance before the final destination.

structural_cues: The phrase غلاظ شداد over the fire in 66:6 precedes اغلظ in 66:9, which itself immediately names Hell as refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical echo, obedience, command, and fire; I infer that the echo both previews consequence and normatively bounds present firmness. A live alternative is that the shared root conveys intensity without transferring the obedience constraint to the Prophet's action.

changed_reading.before: Firmness is emotional hostility toward the addressed groups.
changed_reading.after: Firmness is solid, command-governed boundary enforcement that warns and intervenes before the final consequence, not permission for autonomous cruelty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across three consecutive ayat, k-f-r shifts from persons who cover truth to the covering-away of confessed wrong and back to the focus noun. Sincere turning and protective forgiveness separate two morally opposite coverings: one preserves falsehood from exposure; the other removes sin's damaging trace after exposure and return.

activation_trace.role: Blocking truth supplies the resistant covering that reaches the no-excuse address.
The summoned return opens an alternative movement before confrontation.
Freedom from admixture distinguishes exposed, undivided return from double presentation.
Covering that effaces a wrong supplies the merciful reversal of resistant concealment.
Protective covering of sin shields the returning person from its effect.
The focus noun reactivates covering as the mechanism the Prophet must resist.

structural_cues: The k-f-r root recurs in 66:7, reverses verbal direction in 66:8, and returns as the object الكفار in 66:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root recurrence, repentance, and forgiveness; I infer that the juxtaposition contrasts resistant and reparative covering. A live alternative is that the theological senses remain conventional and should not be mechanistically linked.

changed_reading.before: الكفار names a fixed external class whose defining feature is simply disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The focus resists an active kind of covering that protects falsehood, while the immediately available alternative is honest return followed by a merciful covering that erases harm rather than truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Light moves purposefully ahead and through the interval before the Prophet is told to exert himself. This activates the baseline clear-road and emergence branches: prophetic confrontation can preserve a visible, traversable public route against cover and tunnel-like bypass.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the visible medium through which the route can be followed.
Purposeful motion toward an aim makes the light active rather than merely ambient.
A connection standing between endpoints lets the illuminated interval function as a route.
The before-the-hands orientation locates that moving light immediately ahead.
The clear-road branch of the prophetic title receives concrete illumination from the preceding ayah.
Making a path or truth emerge turns exertion into maintenance of visibility.
Covering is the route-obscuring counterforce.
A tunnel with an outlet is the covert alternate route that avoids the illuminated way.

structural_cues: The moving light before and beside believers closes 66:8; the very next words address the Prophet and command جاهد.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moving light, forward orientation, clear-road and emergence branches, cover, and tunnel; I infer a public-route mechanism joining them. A live alternative is that 66:8's eschatological light remains temporally separate from the focus command.

changed_reading.before: The aim of confrontation is only to overcome opponents.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory co-reading makes its aim the visibility and navigability of a public revelatory route, resisting both obscuring cover and accountability-avoiding bypass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus paired examples deny transferable shelter through intimate proximity: failed fidelity makes righteous spouses unable to suffice, while separation from an oppressive household opens a requested dwelling and rescue. The categories opposed in 66:9 can therefore cut through the closest affiliations, and مأوى is formed by fidelity rather than inherited from one's camp.

activation_trace.role: Deficient fidelity identifies an intimate failure of trust rather than a merely external camp.
Failure of sufficiency blocks borrowed protection from a righteous relation.
Entry into an interior makes destination personally traversed rather than transferred by affiliation.
Building by joining parts supplies the deliberate construction of an alternative belonging.
Dwelling and refuge provide the positive spatial counterpart to the focus ayah's condemned shelter.
Deliverance by separation makes loyal departure from the apparent camp possible.
The focus refuge becomes one term in the paired destination test.
Settled destination makes the result of fidelity or betrayal spatially final.

structural_cues: Immediately after 66:9, paired examples for disbelievers and believers oppose entry into fire with a requested house in the garden, and both examples cross household allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intimate betrayal, failed sufficiency, separation, rescue, and opposed dwellings; I infer that the examples test the focus categories across social proximity. A live alternative is that they teach individual accountability without redefining the confrontation's social reach.

changed_reading.before: الكفار and المنافقين are stable external camps, and refuge follows visible group proximity.
changed_reading.after: The opposed mechanisms can inhabit intimate relations: proximity cannot transfer shelter, betrayal can place one inside the condemned destination, and faithful separation can build another home.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final example combines an enclosing defense with a guarded opening, an entering breath or life-force, and confirmed communicative words. In contrast to hypocrisy's deceptive outlet, this suggests that sound غلظ is not total sealedness but selective permeability: resistant to illicit breach while receptive to life and truthful communication.

activation_trace.role: Preservation inside a surrounding fort supplies an intact protective boundary.
An open vulnerable frontier supplies the boundary point that requires guarding rather than erasure.
Sending breath into something supplies legitimate passage across the protected boundary.
Life-bearing spirit makes that admitted passage generative rather than corrupting.
Verification in act supplies the criterion for what the guarded boundary receives.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies truthful communication across that boundary.
Bodily thickness supplies the material boundary image being re-read.
A presented gate with a concealed exit supplies the corrupt alternative to guarded permeability.

structural_cues: The surah closes after 66:9 with a sequence of guarding an opening, admitted breath, and confirmation of words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, opening, passage, life, and confirmed words; I infer a boundary-design analogy for غلظ against نفاق. A live alternative is that the final example's embodied creation scene should not be generalized into the confrontation's ethics.

changed_reading.before: Firmness means becoming closed and impermeable.
changed_reading.after: In this exploratory model, firmness is selective boundary integrity: block deceptive exits and corrupt breach while remaining open to life-bearing spirit and verifiable speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the arrow that veers without scratching is a form-distant branch under the Prophet's root, not the ordinary sense of النبي. It remains anchored by the title and by 66:3's partial disclosure and turning-aside, which jointly permit precision within firmness. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for calibrated intervention, not as a lexical gloss or an override of the explicit severity command.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النبي and اغلظ stand together, allowing the title's non-wounding arrow branch to qualify how precision can coexist with firmness.

activation_trace.role: An arrow that changes course without scratching supplies the odd image of forceful yet non-wounding precision.
Severe dealing keeps the analogy from dissolving confrontation into mere softness.
Partition into portions gives the intervention a selective target.
Turning aside from part of the matter supplies restraint after accurate exposure.

changed_reading.before: Firm confrontation succeeds by maximizing impact on every exposed target.
changed_reading.after: A contained material analogy allows firm intervention to be precisely redirected, exposing what matters while withholding unnecessary injury.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because depletion through repeated mixing or use comes from a dairy, pasture, and resource branch of جهد. It remains anchored in the imperative and in the focus objects' cover-and-tunnel mechanisms, while 66:8 adds competitive striving. Downstream prose should mark it as a resource analogy for sustained pressure, never as the direct lexical meaning of جاهد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاهد governs opponents represented by cover and a passage with an outlet, so the exertion branch of depletion can model pressure on their evasive capacity.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustion through repeated mixing or use supplies a resource-depletion model of sustained confrontation.
Covering identifies one evasive capacity that repeated exposure can consume.
A through-passage identifies the alternate-route capacity that sustained pressure can close or exhaust.
Competition in striving supplies the adjacent context for pressure sustained against another effort.

changed_reading.before: جهاد is imagined only as direct collision.
changed_reading.after: A contained alternative imagines sustained engagement that drains the systems' ability to keep generating cover and escape routes.

strongest_changes: The opening correction bounds اغلظ as targeted, law-governed firmness rather than generalized severity.
The k-f-r reversal across 66:7-9 distinguishes truth-preserving concealment from merciful covering after sincere return.
The address sequence distributes guarding and repentance to believers while locating public confrontation in prophetic office.
The post-focus household examples show that betrayal, fidelity, refuge, and destination cut across visible affiliation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a junction of concealment mechanics, calibrated disclosure, moving light, guarded boundaries, and competing refuges. Several readings coexist: anti-evasion pressure, command-bound firmness, public route maintenance, non-transferable shelter, and exploratory selective permeability.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the clear-road and moving-light linkage is intended sequence or only a productive branch-level analogy.
How far the household secrecy episode should specify the public category of hypocrisy.
Whether the selective-permeability and non-wounding models can inform prose without being mistaken for lexical glosses.
